about: MihawkBrowser in the approved prototype (owner approval 2026-10-16: surface, Downloads flyout, taskbar pin after Terminal, icon B3). Boxes are CSS pixels at 96 DPI in client coordinates: x, y from the window body's top-left (below the 32 px title bar, inside the 1 px border). pixels are composited RGB at client points [x, y]; hover and press are the pointer over the part. Regenerate with tools/measure-browser-prototype.mjs.
font: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", "Proton UI", Selawik, system-ui, sans-serif
